description: The chart presents the distribution of difficulty levels in knowledge crosswords as assessed by zero-shot evaluations, with three categories: easy, medium, and hard. There are a total of 12 slices representing different difficulty levels, each with a distinct color and percentage. The 'easy' category has three slices: 55.4% for N+K+, 38.3% for N-K+, and 1.7% for N+K-. The 'medium' category also has three slices: 58.8% for N+K+, 35.4% for N-K+, and 1.8% for N+K-. The 'hard' category has four slices: 37.3% for N+K+, 37.9% for N-K+, 18.1% for N-K+, and 6.7% for N+K-. The chart includes a legend on the right side, with color coding for each difficulty level. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The chart does not indicate any specific order of the slices, such as descending size.
